designBasis: Original existing Monster Expedition species and map layouts. No third-party franchise image or map references supplied.

prompts.creaturesFront:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game creature atlas, transparent PNG. Create a square 2048x2048 sprite atlas with EXACTLY SIX equally sized columns and SIX equally sized rows, no gutters between virtual cells but every character contained in the middle 78% of its cell, no labels or grid lines. Transparent background, no cast shadow outside characters. Orthographic front three-quarter RPG battle view, all facing camera slightly to the left, full bodies, feet aligned near 85% height of each cell. Polished soft 2.5D hand-painted miniature/3D toy art: smooth modeled volumes, subtle painterly textures, soft warm upper-left light, crisp readable silhouette, emerald/cream earthy harmonious palette with elemental accent colors. ORIGINAL creature designs, not existing franchise creatures. Evolution families visibly related, no pixel art. Each row exactly these subjects in order:
Row1: 1 tiny orange flame-crested fox-bear; 2 larger orange flame bear with rings of fire around forearms; 3 mighty volcanic ash burrowing bear with rocky plates and back crater; 4 tiny round blue water droplet seal; 5 medium blue river seal with wavy tail fins; 6 big blue sea lion with coral and rock armor.
Row2: 7 small green bean creature two leaf sprout atop head; 8 green vine bean warrior with purple thorn vines; 9 huge walking broadleaf tree guardian with bird nest; 10 tiny brown cream songbird; 11 sleek gray brown hawk with sharp feathers; 12 green striped caterpillar with tiny feet.
Row3: 13 green hanging leaf cocoon with subtle face; 14 luminous pastel violet blue butterfly; 15 tiny tan field mouse with grain cheeks; 16 sturdy larger brown field mouse carrying grain backpack; 17 tiny golden electric kitten, zigzag whiskers; 18 sleek golden electric lynx with blue lightning tail.
Row4: 19 small turquoise water frog; 20 bigger turquoise muddy warrior frog; 21 small russet fox with glowing ember ears; 22 majestic russet fox with flowing flaming fur; 23 small animated moss-gray rounded boulder with feet; 24 massive stone tortoise with mountain shell.
Row5: 25 tiny cream stem purple spotted mushroom; 26 tall elder purple mushroom with droplet cap markings; 27 tiny brown mole with closed eyes and digging paws; 28 big armored mole with shovel forepaws; 29 tiny translucent turquoise lavender jellyfish; 30 grand bioluminescent blue-purple jellyfish with flowing tentacles.
Row6: 31 legendary basalt lava dragon with molten fissures; 32 legendary deep blue aquatic sovereign with long fins and crest; 33 legendary thunderbird black-gold feathers and electric wings; 34 legendary white sky guardian winged qilin creature with airy lavender cloud mane; last two cells EMPTY transparent.
Keep each silhouette entirely inside its cell. NO scenery, no typography, no watermark. Need genuine alpha transparency.
prompts.playerMotion:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production original RPG player animation atlas. Transparent square2048 PNG EXACT4 columns x4rows invisible equal cells. SAME original young adventurer in all16cells: brown wavy hair, NO baseball cap, teal short hooded capelet over coral red jacket, cream shirt, brown cropped trousers, leather ankle boots, mustard yellow crossbody field satchel. Cozy 2.5D smooth hand-painted 3D miniature style, warm upperleft light, no pixel art, no brand logos, distinct original design. Full body occupying center70% width/80% height of each cell, consistent scale, body and foot anchoring consistent, NO props beyond clothing and satchel, transparent background, no shadow floor, no text or grid.
ROWS ARE DIRECTIONS, COLUMNS ARE POSES:
row1 facing toward viewer (south); row2 facing away from viewer (north); row3 profile looking screen-left(west); row4 profile looking screen-right(east).
Columns across ALL rows: column1 neutral standing idle with feet apart, arms at sides; column2 walking left foot forward right arm forward and right foot back; column3 walking right foot forward left arm forward and left foot back; column4 attack/throw pose with torso rotated and right arm reaching forward, left arm balancing behind, one foot planted and other extended. Clear actual hand/leg differences, not four copies. View orthographic slightly elevated20 degrees for all16cells. Do not change clothing or face between frames. Genuine alpha.
prompts.terrain:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production terrain texture atlas for a 2.5D RPG. Square2048 image with EXACT4columns and4rows of equally sized square texture swatches NO gaps or labels. Each swatch covers entire own cell fully opaque, orthographic TOPDOWN texture view, soft painterly miniature material with subtle volume not perspective, muted warm natural palette; readable textures at small scale, no obvious big focal objects. Tileable textures without borders or artificial vignette. Row1: dense soft sage green short grass; warm ochre compacted footpath earth; deep moss-green forest floor; turquoise gently rippled lake water. Row2: red terracotta overlapping roof tiles; forest-green shingle roof; slate-blue ceramic roof tiles; weathered gray slate roof tiles. Row3: warm honey wood planks; pale cream limestone floor slabs; cool gray masonry wall; ivory plaster stucco wall. Row4: rugged tan canyon cliff face texture with horizontal stratification; ash gray volcanic soil; glowing orange molten lava with dark fissures; warm cream sand with tiny pebbles.
No UI, people, creatures, grid separators, text, or watermark. Must look like original painted game materials, never pixelart.

Convert EVERY creature to its REAR THREEQUARTER battle view, facing away from viewer slightly toward upper-right, so only backs visible not faces. prompts.charactersBack: Edit target: supplied transparent original human atlas. Create the matching BACK view atlas: EXACT7columns4rows same27characters in row-major order last cell empty. Every person faces directly AWAY from camera, showing back of head/hair, clothing backs and backpacks, no face or eyes. Preserve each original costume/colors/age/body size/hair and exact cell position. Row1column1 teal-caped coral jacket young traveler with mustard satchel, row3column3 mint green bobbed herbal healer cream tunic sage apron herb bag green leaf pin (no nurse cap/cross). Same smooth soft hand-painted 2.5D miniature style, consistent scale, full bodies visible, feet apart, arms apart suitable for rigged walking. Orthographic slightly elevated RPG camera.
